Green Square Capital Raised Its Lockheed Martin (LMT) Position; As Schlumberger LTD (SLB) Share Price Declined, Hourglass Capital Raised Holding by $2.25 Million
May 6, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Green Square Capital Llc increased its stake in Lockheed Martin Corp (LMT) by 31.17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Green Square Capital Llc bought 7,178 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.55% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 30,207 shares of the military and government and technical company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.70M, up from 23,029 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Green Square Capital Llc who had been investing in Lockheed Martin Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $88.93B market cap company. The stock increased 0.49% or $1.51 during the last trading session, reaching $311.44. About 1.68 million shares traded. Lockheed Martin Corporation (NYSE:LMT) has risen 26.83% since May 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 15.28% the S&P500.
Hourglass Capital Llc increased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (SLB) by 31.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hourglass Capital Llc bought 33,515 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.39% with the market. The hedge fund held 140,024 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.44 million, up from 106,509 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hourglass Capital Llc who had been investing in Schlumberger Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $95.28 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.58% or $1.07 during the last trading session, reaching $68.79. About 5.62M shares traded.
